experiment: flashnext (R9700) + BTL-4 Compact IQ2_XXS (Strix iGPU) co-residency
setup: flashnext via Strata on R9700 (production lane); BTL-4 Compact 9.28 GiB IQ2_XXS via llama.cpp dual-arch build pinned HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 (iGPU GTT), ctx 32768, reasoning-format deepseek, --jinja
correctness_gate: PASS - Paris (after reasoning completes; thinking model needs ~150 reasoning tokens first, max_tokens 32 truncated it)

analysis.BTL4_loss_concurrent: about 6-8% vs its own quiet baseline
analysis.verdict: VIABLE PAIRING - both stay near-full speed concurrently. BTL4 fills the idle iGPU using only ~11GB of the 120GB GTT, leaving room for a second iGPU model

notes: BTL-4 is a thinking model: blank content plus long reasoning_content at low max_tokens is normal; gate passed once reasoning completes
Combined: flashnext ~80GB (RAM+VRAM) + BTL4 ~11GB iGPU GTT = fits the 124GB box with headroom
Both servers survive concurrent hammering; no errors, no OOM
